messages:
Maya (SRE): heads-up — I'm handing off the active P1 (INC-2025-142) now, paging rotation forces me offline in 10m. brief: embeddings-eu requester latency spike -> 503s for customers in eu-west1. I've scaled and applied temporary routing but still seeing errors. taking Samir as driver, need comms owner. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-p1

Samir Patel: ack — I'm taking driver. quick q: what's current routing? are we on fallback model variant or primary?

Maya (SRE): we're currently routed to model-redwood/emb-v3-quant (fallback) for euw1 while primary is failing. traffic split is 80% fallback / 20% primary. KV cache miss rate spiked which looks like connection churn to the cache layer. mitigation applied: scaled inference-euw1 pool +2 GPUs and pinned to quantized kernel; also disabled request-prefetch batching for this route. logs: ```
# tail -n 40 /var/log/inference/euw1/serving.log
[14:02:12] ERROR downstream kv get timeout 3000ms
[14:02:13] WARN batcher queue length spike 230
[14:02:15] 503 responded to 120 reqs in 60s
```

Olivia Chen: I'll take comms. drafting an external note: need customer-visible summary + ETA. Maya — do we have an estimated time to stabilize or rollback to a known-good model?

Maya (SRE): no solid ETA yet. tentative plan: if error rate doesn't drop within 20m after scale, we roll back traffic to model-redwood/emb-v2-stable (previous stable) and trigger a canary deploy for v3. rollback command: ``kubectl set image deployment/inference-euw1 model=image:emb-v2-stable --record``. runbook link above has the rollback checklist.

Samir Patel: ok I'll monitor metrics and do the rollback if errors stay >5% for 2 consecutive 60s windows. I'll also run the KV health check. Nate — can you confirm redis/kv cluster connectivity from the inference nodes?

Nate Rivera: on it. running quick health probe + grabbing netstat from one of the pods. snippet: ``curl -s http://kv-euw1:8080/health | jq .status`` returning "degraded" on 2/5 instances. looks like a partial network flake between AZs.

Jules: adding — I pushed a tiny routing change 6m ago to route ~10% away from the most impacted AZ; might be related. reverting that is trivial if you want me to: ``routedb rollback 2025-03-15-14:00``

Samir Patel: please hold on revert for now — I'd prefer to observe after the scale completes. Maya — any active customer escalations?

Maya (SRE): yes one enterprise customer on-support called in; ops ticket INC-2025-142-CU1 opened. Olivia please include that in the comms. Also, set priority: do not escalate to infra incident commander unless rollback fails.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2025-142 status CHANGED -> investigation in progress. Current assignees: driver=Samir Patel, comms=Olivia Chen. Next escalation in 20m if status unchanged.

Olivia Chen: drafting external note now. Short update: "We're investigating increased error rates for embeddings in eu-west1; mitigation in progress; expected next update in 20 minutes." I'll post once Samir confirms driver handoff.

Samir Patel: handoff confirmed — I'm driver. immediate actions I'm running: (1) KV health triage (Nate), (2) monitor error-rate & p50/p95 latency (me), (3) prepare rollback artifact and rehearse on staging. tagging runbook steps: step 4a (scale), 4b (routing), 5 (rollback).

Maya (SRE): thanks. I'm going offline in ~8m — leave me a final note if anything important changes. Samir — if you need rapid help, @Maya will be reachable on phone for the next 8m.

Nate Rivera: KV probe returned: 2 instances degraded, cause appears to be intermittent connection resets from inference pool IPs. opening ticket to networking: NET-4678.

Samir Patel: thanks. initiating rollback prep now. Olivia — last ask: please include a call-to-action for customers to retry in 10 minutes and mention we're prioritizing availability.

Olivia Chen: noted. posting external update now. :loudspeaker:

Maya (SRE): handing off completed — Samir driving, Olivia comms, Nate infra checks, Jules on routing revert standby. good handover, thanks all. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: received handoff. I'll post next update at +15m or earlier if we hit rollback.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Next scheduled update for INC-2025-142 in 15 minutes. Escalation timer set for 20 minutes.
